From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned and hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Historical Inscription Of Southern India · Robert Sewell · 1932, 460 scanned pages. Published 1932; Robert Sewell died 1925 and Sakkottai Krishnaswami Aiyangar 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit.
